description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Llanowar Scout as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.
